description: apply_finger_of_death_damage targets query is Without<Wizard> only — no Without<GhostEntity>. On the guest peer, the beam can mutate Health on host ghost units (which carry a real Health component via CRDT), causing local-only HP divergence. Additionally, DeathmarkDebuff is inserted on ghost units (line 217), which can trigger spurious chain beams when the ghost's CRDT-replicated HP transitions to ≤0 locally.
recommendation: Add Without<crate::game::multiplayer::components::GhostEntity> to the targets query filter-tuple, matching the pattern in entangle/casting/root_effects.rs:66 with its explanatory comment.

description: update_reapers_scythe targets query (Without<Wizard>) has no Without<GhostEntity>. The per-frame sweep damage loop runs for the full 1-second sweep duration and can mutate guest ghost unit Health on every tick, causing HP divergence from host-authoritative CRDT state.
recommendation: Add Without<crate::game::multiplayer::components::GhostEntity> to the targets query in update_reapers_scythe.

description: apply_necrotic_explosion_damage targets query (Without<Wizard>) has no Without<GhostEntity>. Every NecroticExplosionBurst applies AoE damage on its first tick to all non-Wizard entities in radius, which includes ghost units with Health components.
recommendation: Add Without<crate::game::multiplayer::components::GhostEntity> to the targets query in apply_necrotic_explosion_damage.

description: update_deathmark_debuffs all_enemies query (Without<Wizard>) has no Without<GhostEntity>. A ghost unit implanted with DeathmarkDebuff (via the unfixed F1 path) will trigger chain-beam emission when its locally-visible HP reaches ≤0, causing a spurious beam that then passes through the ungated damage system. Prerequisite: fix the targets query in apply_finger_of_death_damage (F1) to prevent debuff insertion on ghosts.
recommendation: Add Without<crate::game::multiplayer::components::GhostEntity> to both the marked_targets and all_enemies queries in update_deathmark_debuffs.

description: check_grease_ignition queries GreaseZone without Without<GhostSpellEffect>. Ghost grease zones are full GreaseZone entities on the guest. Fire-source queries (fireball_explosions at line 41, wall_of_fires at line 43, etc.) also lack Without<GhostSpellEffect>, so a ghost fireball explosion can trigger ignition on a ghost zone. Once ignited, apply_grease_burn runs on that ghost zone with no Without<GhostEntity> guard on targets (line 269), causing duplicate burn damage to real units.
recommendation: Add Without<GhostSpellEffect> to the zones query. Add Without<GhostSpellEffect> to all six fire-source queries in check_grease_ignition.

description: apply_grease_burn queries GreaseZone without Without<GhostSpellEffect>. On the guest, this processes ghost zones and the targets query (line 269) has no Without<GhostEntity> filter, causing duplicate burn damage to real units from ghost zones triggered by ghost fire sources.
recommendation: Add Without<GhostSpellEffect> to the zone query and Without<GhostEntity> to the targets query in apply_grease_burn.

description: apply_grease_slow queries GreaseZone without Without<GhostSpellEffect>. On the guest this increments ghost zone time_alive (enabling cleanup_grease_zone to despawn ghosts prematurely), and runs Slip and Fall stun and Oil Slick vulnerability paths on units near ghost zones. Targets query (line 34) also lacks Without<GhostEntity>.
recommendation: Add Without<GhostSpellEffect> to the zone query and Without<GhostEntity> to the targets query in apply_grease_slow.

description: cleanup_grease_zone calls try_despawn on GreaseZone entities when time_alive >= duration, with no Without<GhostSpellEffect> filter. Ghost zone time_alive is incremented locally (via apply_grease_slow), so the guest will despawn ghost zones on its local clock, out of sync with the host snapshot managed by ghost_spawn.rs.
recommendation: Add Without<GhostSpellEffect> to cleanup_grease_zone's zone query. Ghost zone lifecycle is already managed by ghost_spawn.rs when the host removes them from the snapshot.

description: update_grease_regeneration and cleanup_grease_debuffs (line 136) lack Without<GhostSpellEffect> on their zone queries. Regeneration on ghost zones would reset time_alive and remove GreaseIgnited on the guest, corrupting ghost visual state.
recommendation: Add Without<GhostSpellEffect> to both zone queries in update_grease_regeneration and cleanup_grease_debuffs.

description: apply_wall_of_fire_damage and cleanup_wall_of_fire have no Without<GhostSpellEffect> filter. On the guest client, host walls are replicated as WallOfFireEffect with GhostSpellEffect and start=ZERO, end=ZERO, damage_per_tick=0.0. The zero-damage sentinel mitigates HP damage but: (a) time_alive advances via local delta racing CRDT; (b) TerrainDamageMessage fires with position Vec3::ZERO; (c) InsideWallOfFire and FirestormMarked can be inserted on local units near origin; (d) cleanup_wall_of_fire despawns ghost walls via local timer, potentially racing snapshot reconciliation and emitting spurious ObstacleChanged::Removed.
recommendation: Add Without<GhostSpellEffect> to both apply_wall_of_fire_damage and cleanup_wall_of_fire queries, mirroring apply_explosion_damage/cleanup_finished_explosions in the fireball module.

description: spawn_explosion_bubbles has no Without<GhostSpellEffect> filter. Ghost fireball explosions on the guest have ExplosionBubbleSpawner. When triggered, sub-bubbles are spawned with OnGameplayScreen (line 270) instead of OnMultiplayerGameScreen, so they leak and are not cleaned up when the multiplayer game screen is torn down.
recommendation: Add Without<GhostSpellEffect> to the spawners query, or propagate the correct screen-lifetime marker from the parent explosion entity (the spawn_fireball_visuals generic M: Component + Clone pattern shows how).

description: `spawn_pandemic_clouds` runs on both peers (`is_spell_effects_active`) and its `clouds` query has no `Without<GhostSpellEffect>` filter. In MP the guest holds ghost copies of host-cast clouds. When a unit dies near a ghost cloud, the guest spuriously spawns a local authoritative child cloud, firing `ObstacleChanged` events and dealing damage from the wrong peer.
recommendation: Add `Without<crate::game::multiplayer::components::GhostSpellEffect>` to the `clouds` query, mirroring `move_plague_wind_cloud` and `apply_plague_wind_damage`.

description: `apply_spike_growth_damage` runs on both peers (`is_spell_effects_active`) and its `zones` query has no `Without<GhostSpellEffect>` filter. In MP the guest has ghost copies of all host-cast `SpikeGrowthZone` entities. The guest applies zone damage, inserts `ZonePresenceTracker`/`SpikeGrowthLingeringPoison` on ghost units, and emits spurious talent progress increments from the wrong peer.
recommendation: Add `Without<crate::game::multiplayer::components::GhostSpellEffect>` to the `zones` query, matching `apply_plague_wind_damage`.

description: `spike_storm_volley` runs on both peers and queries `zones` without a `GhostSpellEffect` filter. On the guest, every ghost zone with `spike_storm = true` periodically spawns local `SpikeStormProjectile` entities (not networked) that deal redundant damage to ghost units via `update_spike_storm_projectiles`.
recommendation: Add `Without<GhostSpellEffect>` to the `zones` query in `spike_storm_volley`; also consider gating `update_spike_storm_projectiles` to `is_gameplay_running` if Spike Storm projectiles are intentionally not networked.

description: process_chain_lightning_bounces queries enemies without Without<GhostEntity>. In multiplayer the guest ghost army receives arc damage from chain lightning bounces on the host, corrupting ghost simulation state.
recommendation: Add Without<crate::game::multiplayer::components::GhostEntity> to the enemies query filter at line 44. Mirror the pattern already used in healing_plume/casting.rs:298.

description: enemies_query and health_query in handle_chain_lightning_casting and chain_lightning_casting_logic lack Without<GhostEntity>. The initial damage hit on cast can strike ghost units.
recommendation: Add Without<crate::game::multiplayer::components::GhostEntity> to enemies_query (line 54) and to the health_query (lines 57-61).

description: ArcTargetFilter type alias excludes LightningStrike entities but not GhostEntity. The update_lightning_strikes system's units query will therefore arc-damage ghost units, running damage twice — once per peer.
recommendation: Add Without<crate::game::multiplayer::components::GhostEntity> to ArcTargetFilter at line 39.

description: spawn_phantom_units iterates all PhantomFogZone entities without excluding GhostSpellEffect ghost zones. Ghost FogCloudZone entities on the guest are spawned with PhantomFogZone { spawn_timer: 0.0 } (ghost_effect_spawn.rs:180). The fog_cloud plugin runs under is_spell_effects_active (guest-inclusive), so after ~3 s the guest ghost zone triggers local phantom unit spawns — real Team::Defenders entities that exist only on the guest, are not networked, and pollute all-unit queries.
recommendation: Add Without<crate::game::multiplayer::components::GhostSpellEffect> to the zones query in spawn_phantom_units, matching the host-only intent stated in ghost_effect_spawn.rs comment.

description: apply_fog_cloud_evasion (line 15) and apply_blinding_mist (line 44) both iterate all non-corpse units without excluding GhostEntity. Ghost units have Health and Team. While combat evasion is host-only, the update_timed_modifier::<FogEvasionModifier> system in units/plugin.rs runs on the guest and will tick and remove ghost evasion modifiers every frame, creating spurious ECS churn.
recommendation: Add Without<crate::game::multiplayer::components::GhostEntity> to the targets queries in apply_fog_cloud_evasion and apply_blinding_mist.

description: update_sleep_modifiers queries all SleepModifier entities without Without<GhostEntity>. On the guest, ghost units intentionally receive SleepModifier for local visual feedback via status_forwarding. The tick expires and removes SleepModifier (plus NightTerrors, Comatose, NarcolepticWave, Sleepwalking) on ghost units ahead of host-authoritative timing, diverging guest visual state from host truth. Same gap applies to update_night_terrors (line 107) and update_narcoleptic_wave (line 132).
recommendation: Add Without<GhostEntity> to the query filter in update_sleep_modifiers, update_night_terrors, and update_narcoleptic_wave.

description: update_sleepwalkers overrides TargetingVelocity for all Sleepwalking entities without Without<GhostEntity>. On the guest, ghost units that receive Sleepwalking for visual feedback would have targeting velocity overridden by the guest's LocalSpellOrigin rather than being driven by the host snapshot.
recommendation: Add Without<GhostEntity> to the query in update_sleepwalkers.

description: handle_haste_expiry (chain-haste propagation + momentum buff insertion) and tick_haste_slow_zone (applies SlowMovementModifier to units) lack Without<GhostEntity> guards. Chain-haste propagation inserts HasteModifier/ChainHasteSource on additional ghost entities — components not forwarded to the host — causing silent gameplay divergence on the guest side.
recommendation: Add Without<GhostEntity> to all three queries in handle_haste_expiry and to tick_haste_slow_zone's unit query.

description: update_battle_hymn_modifier ticks all BattleHymnModifier entities without Without<GhostEntity>. On the guest, ghost units with BattleHymnModifier (forwarded to host on apply) will have it expired and removed locally ahead of host-authoritative timing. The EchoingSong re-apply path also fires on ghost entities.
recommendation: Add Without<GhostEntity> to the query in update_battle_hymn_modifier.

description: update_mind_controlled_targeting (line 27), update_mind_control_wear_off (line 109), and mind_controlled_combat (line 174) query MindControlled units without Without<GhostEntity>. In multiplayer, status_receive.rs:303 inserts MindControlled onto units by network ID. If ghost units on the host receive MC status, these systems would mutate their TargetingVelocity, tick time_elapsed, and apply damage from ghost MC attackers. mind_controlled_pursue_allies correctly uses Without<GhostEntity> via MindControlPursuitFilter:17.
recommendation: Add Without<GhostEntity> to the controlled query in update_mind_controlled_targeting, update_mind_control_wear_off, and mind_controlled_combat.
